## getHomePublicKeysDir() function

Get the user's home public keys directory.

This returns \~/.attest-it/public-keys by default, which is different from the config directory (\~/.config/attest-it). The public keys directory is designed to be easily shareable and discoverable.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function getHomePublicKeysDir(homeDir?: string): string;
```
